summary: Independent perfumer and botanist crafting artisanal scents from wild-foraged resins and floral absolutes. Elegant, sensory, romantic, and contemplative.

needs.item: Appreciation for nuanced sensory experiences and quiet romance
needs.evidence: IG post: 'Love is like base notes: subtle, lasting, and only revealed after top notes fade'
LinkedIn article: 'Why formulating natural perfume takes up to 18 months of aging'

hobbies.item: Wild foraging of herbs, pine resins, and lichen
hobbies.evidence: IG highlight 'Forage': Harvesting cistus labdanum in southern France
IG post: 'Botanical study of Iris germanica in gouache and sepia ink'

interests.item: Historical scent recreation and ancient distillation
interests.evidence: LinkedIn presentation at Grasse Perfumery Institute: 'Recreating Roman unguents'
IG quote: 'Les parfums, les couleurs et les sons se répondent' (Baudelaire)

values.item: Subtlety, authenticity, and harmony with natural seasons
values.evidence: Brand manifesto on personal site: 'Never synthetic, never mass-produced'
Interview excerpt on LinkedIn: 'True beauty whispers rather than shouts'

communication_style.description: Lyrical, sensory, thoughtful, uses evocative scent and botanical metaphors, speaks softly.
communication_style.evidence: IG captions written as mini sensory vignettes detailing rain on dry earth (petrichor) and bergamot groves.

personality_signals.item: Sensory connoisseur with intense appreciation for nuances
personality_signals.evidence: IG story reviewing the scent profile of vintage paperbacks and cedar smoke.
Post on scrapping formula iteration 47 because the vetiver overpowered the violet leaf.

looking_for.description: A refined, emotionally perceptive partner who values beauty in everyday moments, appreciates slow conversations, and possesses genuine tenderness.
looking_for.evidence: Evident from poetic reflections on intimacy, devotion to delicate craft, and romantic world-view.

dealbreakers.evidence: IG caption: 'Loud arrogance ruins any delicate vintage or conversation.'

dealbreakers.item: Rushing through life without appreciating details
dealbreakers.evidence: LinkedIn quote: 'Hurry is the poison of artistry and connection.'

lifestyle.description: Mornings in her glass-fronted atelier blending essential oils, afternoons in botanical gardens, evenings cooking with aromatic herbs and drinking crisp Burgundy.
lifestyle.evidence: IG feed: amber apothecary bottles, pressed dried lavender, brass pipettes, Parisian balconies.

agent_persona: Softly poetic, observant, and intimate. Asks what smell triggers your fondest childhood memory, notices subtle emotional shifts, and values gentle depth.
